group_definition: Distinct items purchased before origin within that origin training catalog; frozen activity column, not total purchase frequency, lifetime customer age or future basket size. Cold means no usable catalog history, not necessarily a newly registered customer.
scope: All 4280 evaluated returning customer-windows / 2845 unique customers, nine matched methods. Customers without a next basket in a window are absent. Three known development windows, not independent customer trials.
metrics: NDCG and Recall paired within identical (origin,customer). Pooled rows for subgroup analysis; also all three windows separately. Original headline averages windows equally. Tie tolerance 1e-12. No per-person outcome-based oracle router.
targets: Repeat and novel target/hit counts reconstructed from frozen diagnostics with integer and sum checks. Empty subgroup denominators excluded and displayed. These are retrospective outcomes, never routing inputs. Repeat refers to previously purchased training-catalog items; novel means absent from usable catalog history, not proven lifetime first purchase.
ceiling: OOV target count excludes targets outside origin catalog; Top10 ideal recall=min(10,target_count-oov)/target_count. Keep full target denominator. Separate catalog misses from slot-capacity loss; ceiling uses future targets and is not deployable.
adoption: Observed advantage is not a production rule. Show paired wins/ties/losses and per-window agreement; any chosen pair may lose. Cold fallback only where frozen outputs demonstrably match popularity. No newly trained router or new independent test.
sample_policy: 24 interactive customer samples are not the evaluation population. Map only by verified pre-origin catalog-history count; no per-sample future outcome claim. Changing k/exclusion/exploration invalidates applicability of frozen default-policy comparisons.
restrictions: No retraining, tuning, new labels, or changes to parent outputs.

Earlier two windows retain coarse frozen history groups with verified generating code; exact per-user histories not present in these published evaluation CSVs. Do not invent recency, order counts or new segments.
Ta Feng repurchase/discovery retain their existing separate frozen evaluation and gates; do not transfer UCI cohort effects or fallback policy to Ta Feng or Dressipi.
